podcast: Dishing Up Digital with Ellen Mackenzie

ca6979055d.q: What are the four key business moves required to reach a 10k month as a social media manager?
ca6979055d.a: The four levers are: prioritizing social proof through case studies and testimonials, shifting to premium pricing with retainer packages of $1,500 to $3,500 per month instead of hourly rates, implementing systems and software to save time, and hiring contractors or team members to handle deliverables so you can focus on sales and strategy.
ca6979055d.e: From $0 to $10k/Month as a Social Media Manager (Honest Breakdown)
ca6979055d.rq: If you want to hit 10k months, you need to focus on premium pricing instead of having eight to ten clients, having three to five on juicy premium packages is going to get you to that 10k month so much faster.

ecc894bc32.q: Why should social media managers charge a minimum of $1,000 USD per month instead of hourly rates?
ecc894bc32.a: Package-based pricing over hourly rates provides stability for both you and the client, eliminates confusion about costs and responsibilities, and allows you to reach 10k months faster. With an average $2,000 retainer you need only five clients versus 20 clients at $500 per month. Social media management is a crucial part of a business's marketing ecosystem and cannot be outsourced to junior staff anymore.

0dce67de67.q: How did Ellen Mackenzie hit her first 10k month six years ago and what was the key trigger?
0dce67de67.a: Ellen hit her first 10k month in Q4 by managing eight different clients with various social media management and strategy packages. The decisive trigger was hiring her first contractor, a former corporate colleague, to handle captions and client engagement for just two hours per week. This small team addition was enough to unlock the 10k milestone after months of hitting $7,000 to $9,000.

6a4c8127d6.q: Why is social proof more important than marketing when scaling to 10k months?
6a4c8127d6.a: Building a strong portfolio with case studies, testimonials, and analytics screenshots allows clients to discover you without needing aggressive sales skills. New social media managers should focus on networking, co-pitching, and building client experience rather than posting generic tips on social media, because portfolio-based content attracts clients far more effectively than posts from someone with no client experience.

06e1f203a7.q: What is Ellen Mackenzie's current monthly revenue and what system change drove the increase?
06e1f203a7.a: Ellen recently hit her first 50k month in New Zealand Dollars by 5x-ing her revenue over six years. The major recent system shift was introducing Claude as an operating system to automate business tasks like GST filing and scheduling, which freed up significant time to take more sales calls and post more content.
